g.text: Development laptop [Deployment Node: Apple silicon, macOS]

text.tspan: mvn package builds the jars the images copy.
No image carries a compiler, so the ten
services are reproducible from one reactor
Every service restart: unless-stopped, which is what makes R-4's
container-kill experiment a recovery measurement. Five ports published,
wait on it before they have anything to do
six dampers and the one fan
page keeps serving when the rest is down
